_comment: sia_D_flat=1 -> mobile clusters diffuse at the MONOMER value, removing the
1.8e6x cliff at n=4 and the D1D/rot_factor (2.7e6) suppression, so raising
i_mobile genuinely raises the interstitial flux.
Z_loop_model=1 -> Wolfer size-dependent loop bias replaces the constant
Z_i^loop; K_grow/K_shrink becomes n-dependent (4.88 at n=5 -> 3.18 at 636)
instead of 2.8602 at every size, so v(n) can have a zero crossing.
Refs: Wolfer & Ashkin JAP 47 (1976) 791; Wolfer, J.Comput.-Aided Mater.Des.
CNM Vol.1 Ch.1.13 (2012).  Capture radii r_c^i=3b, r_c^v=1b are ORDER-OF-
MAGNITUDE defaults, not taken from a table -- replace from source before
publishing.  r_c^v=1b reproduces the legacy Z_v^loop=1.0 exactly.
